clauses.mechanism: revocation of EO 11330 'as amended' by EO 12379 Sec. 17, which removes the section amended by EO 11547 (no effective-date wording, read as on signing)
clauses.reason: whole: EO 11547 (signed 1970-07-10, 35 FR 11221) amends Sec. 101(a) of EO 11330 (President's Council on Youth Opportunity) by substituting a new subsection establishing the Council and setting its membership; its only command is that substitution and it has no own-terms end. First end: EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, 47 FR 36099), whose Sec. 17 reads "Sec. 17. Executive Order No. 11330, as amended, establishing the President’s" and, on the next line, "Council on Youth Opportunity, is revoked." EO 12379 does not name EO 11547 by number; it revokes EO 11330 'as amended', and because EO 11547's whole operative content is the substituted Sec. 101(a) of EO 11330, the revocation of EO 11330 as amended removes the section it amends and ends the clause. EO 12379 has no effective-date wording, so the revocation is read as effective on signing, 1982-08-17. The OFR catalog note on the target reads "Revoked by: EO 12379, August 17, 1982". The dossier's second chain event, dated 1975-01-06 (EO 11829), comes from a source-ladder file filed under EO 11829 that is a reprint of the 47 FR 36099 pages of EO 12379, not an event of 1975. Disclosed alternative reading: if a reviewer holds that an order not named by number is not ended by the revocation of its amended parent, no first end is shown in the held sources.

research_rationale:
EO 11547 (signed 1970-07-10, 35 FR 11221) read in full from the held official FR text, with the relevant parts of EO 11330 and EO 12379. Identity confirmed. The order is a single amendment (substituted Sec. 101(a) of EO 11330). First and whole-order end: EO 12379 Sec. 17 revoking EO 11330 'as amended' (1982-08-17, on signing), reasoned as removal of the section amended; EO 11547 is not named by number, which is stated in the clause reason with the alternative reading. The dossier listed 'target provision not located: EO:12379'; I located Sec. 17 and quote it. A Cruden by-number scan of EO 11330 found only EO 11547 and EO 12379 (and mirrors/reprints) citing it. Savings: none_after_bounded_search. AI producer hypothesis only; not human certification.
